newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish EBS raises variable homeloan rate by 50 bps.
newsitem.headline: Irish EBS raises variable homeloan rate by 50 bps.

text.p: Ireland's EBS Building Society said on Monday that it was raising its variable homeloan interest rate by 50 basis points.
This will bring its base rate to 7.1 percent from 6.6 percent.
The move follows a 50 basis point rise in the official Short Term Facility Rate (STF) by the central bank on May 1.
A number of other lending institutions, including Irish Permanent, Allied Irish Banks, Bank of Ireland and First National Building Society, have already raised their rates.
